title: Get Enrichment Policies
description: Lists the enrichment policies in the Intel Exchange application.

query.name: q
query.description: Pass the enrichment policy name to retrieve the policy.

query.name: is_active
query.description: Pass true to retrieve active policies, else pass false.

query.name: created_by_id
query.description: Pass the user ID to retrieve policies created by the particular user.

query.name: updated_by_id
query.description: Pass the user ID to retrieve policies updated by the particular user.

query.name: created_from
query.description: Pass the created from date in epoch format to retrieve policies created in the provided timestamp.

query.name: created_to
query.description: Pass the created date in epoch format to retrieve policies created in the provided timestamp.

query.name: sort
query.description: Pass `-ctix_created` to sort records by the last modified date in descending order. Pass `ctix_created` to sort records by the last modified date in ascending order.

query.name: object_type
query.description: Pass the object type to filter the enrichment policies on the object type specified in the policy, such as IP, hash, domain, or URL.

query.name: published_collections
query.description: Pass the collection ID to filter the enrichment policies based on published collection IDs.

query.name: collection_id
query.description: Pass the collection ID to filter the enrichment policies based on the collection ID.

query.name: source_id
query.description: Pass the source ID to filter the enrichment policies based on the source ID.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

body.name: next
body.description: Returns a link to the next page of pagination.

body.name: page_size
body.description: Returns the number of records returned on each page.

body.name: previous
body.description: Returns a link to the previous page of pagination.

body.name: results
body.description: Returns JSON objects for the enrichment details.

items.name: all_collections
items.description: Returns true if the policy is configured to receive intel all collections, else returns false.

items.name: all_inbox_collections
items.description: Returns true if the policy is configured to receive intel from all inbox type sources, else returns false.

items.name: all_sources
items.description: Returns true if the policy is configured to receive intel from all sources, else returns false.

items.name: component
items.description: Returns the type of threat data.

items.name: created
items.description: Returns the date and time at which the policy was created in epoch format.

items.name: created_by
items.description: Returns the details of the user who created the policy.

items.name: email
items.description: Returns the user's email address.

items.name: first_name
items.description: Returns the user's first name.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

items.name: last_name
items.description: Returns the user's last name.

items.name: enrichment
items.description: Returns the list of enrichment sources and their details used to enrich the threat data.

items.name: app_name
items.description: Returns the name of the enrichment app.

items.name: app_slug
items.description: Returns the unique slug of the app.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the unique ID of the integration.

items.name: is_active
items.description: Returns true if the integration is currently active.

items.name: order
items.description: Returns the order in which this enrichment app is executed.

items.name: third_party_logo
items.description: Returns the URL path to the logo of the third-party app.

items.name: enrichment_run_type
items.description: Returns the execution style of the policy as sequential or parallelly.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the policy ID.

items.name: is_active
items.description: Returns true if the policy is active, else returns false.

items.name: is_apply_condition
items.description: Returns true if a condition is applied to the policy, else returns false.

items.name: modified
items.description: Returns the date and time at which the policy was last modified in epoch format.

items.name: name
items.description: Returns the name of the policy.

items.name: object_type
items.description: Returns the threat data type to enrich. It can be IP, hash, domain, or URL.

items.name: policy_source
items.description: Returns the list of policy sources, such as ID, name, and source.

items.name: collection
items.description: Returns the list of collections included in the policy.

items.name: inbox
items.description: Returns the list of inbox sources.

items.name: created
items.description: Returns the timestamp of when the inbox was created.

items.name: description
items.description: Returns a brief description of the inbox.

items.name: has_subscribed
items.description: Returns the subscription details.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the ID of the inbox.

items.name: inbox
items.description: Returns true if the source is an inbox.

items.name: is_active
items.description: Returns true if the inbox is active.

items.name: is_editable
items.description: Returns true if the inbox source can be edited.

items.name: name
items.description: Returns the name of the inbox.

items.name: polling
items.description: Returns true if the inbox uses polling.

items.name: type
items.description: Returns the type of inbox.

items.name: source
items.description: Returns the list of direct sources added to the policy.

items.name: priority
items.description: Returns the priority of the policy at which it would be executed.

items.name: rule
items.description: Returns the list of conditions applied to the policy.

items.name: status
items.description: Returns the status of the policy, such as ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

items.name: updated_by
items.description: Returns the name of the user who last modified the policy.

items.name: email
items.description: Returns the user's email address.

items.name: first_name
items.description: Returns the user's first name.

items.name: id
items.description: Returns the user's unique ID.

items.name: last_name
items.description: Returns the user's last name.

body.name: total
body.description: Returns the total number of records retrieved.
